reason: Lending notifies through the injected notifier and keeps all layers separated, though it notifies only on the first lend of a book (a behavior deviation, not an architecture one).
Layers, ports, adapters, handlers and composition root all follow the required dependency rules.
Different module names and helpers, but the domain, application, ports, adapters, handlers and composition root keep the required dependencies.
The package __init__ re-exports every module as a facade, which is an idiom and creates no real cycle among the layer modules.
LendingService.lend never notifies the member, so lending does not notify through the injected notifier.
lend_book reaches into the service's private store via service._store.find, bypassing the application.
InMemoryLoanStore.find takes an int key and returns a list, so the adapter does not satisfy the LoanStore port.
Loan.close imports and instantiates the OutboxNotifier adapter, so the domain depends on an adapter and sends notifications outside the injected notifier.
